notes.title: Achievements and Completion issues hotfix
notes.content:
Hi, I've hopefully fixed the achievements and completion issues. Unfortunately It seems the game was not saving that a level had been completed. Unfortunately this means that any levels completed will still not show as completed unless they are completed again. this issue stemmed from my rework of how the data is loaded into the game to improve performance. 
I sincerely apologise. And I will strive to not have an issue like this happen again.

notes.title: Chroma Cross Holiday Update - Out Now
notes.content:
Happy Holidays! 
I've been working hard the last few weeks on this Update.
Here's a rundown of everything

[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Preview now correctly updates with hint usage
[*] Clues now correctly claim Solve with hint usage
[*] Fixed an issue where pallet colors were rendering incorrectly
[/list]
[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Game mode Mosaics. Solve 15 individual sections of a larger image!
[*] New puzzle set Christmas Mosaic
[*] New Puzzle set Happy Holidays
[*] Added FX for marking off entire lines complete.
[*] Added empty lines are auto filled with Crosses on puzzle start
[*] Added auto selecting the set last viewed when loading the game.
[*] Added the ability to color pick (middle mouse) on clues.
[*] Added a new transition effect between puzzles
[*] Added information on what to expect in the next update
[*] 2 New Achievements
[/list]
[h3]Performance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Massively Improved loading times
[*] removed a stall that would happen when accessing the levels menu for the first time.
[/list]

I recently ran a playtest and recieved a lot of good feedback. My plans for the next update are to address some of the biggest issues raised by the playtesters. I'll get to work on the next update in the new year. Until then, God Jul, Nollaig Shona and Happy Holidays.

notes.title: Chroma Cross Oceans Update Live Now
notes.content:
ChangeLog
[olist]
[*] 2 New Puzzle Sets, 30 New Puzzles, 6 New Achievements.
[*] New Puzzle Set, “Nautical”, 15 new Nautical themed Puzzles.
[*] New Puzzle Set, “Sea Life”, 15 new Puzzles of creatures from the deep.
[*] 6 New Achievements for completing each Puzzle Set.
[/olist]

Thank you so much for playing Chroma Cross Early Access, 
As always I am open to player feedback, Please feel free to Discuss any improvements or changes you would like to see in the future, in the Steam Community.

Thanks,
TheFitzyGames

notes.title: Progress on the next big Update for Chroma Cross
notes.content:
Chroma Cross' next Update will be Ocean and Underwater themed. It will include 2 New puzzle sets (30 new puzzles) 
The Nautical Set and The Sea Creature set

Here's a showcase of some of the Nautical sprites.
